claim: The bundled demo creates an isolated temporary report from shipped sample files.
sandbox: fresh process; supabase-exit-map --demo --json; parse stdout and the printed temporary report

claim: The CLI reports dependency evidence, effort, replacement choices, and a checklist.
where: Landing how-it-works and sample report, README
sandbox: bundled demo JSON; assert representative findings and report fields

claim: The CLI accepts a project root or its supabase directory.
sandbox: bundled sample invoked once from each documented path

claim: The CLI writes JSON and Markdown reports.
sandbox: bundled sample writes JSON and Markdown to a fresh temporary directory

claim: The CLI uses exit code 2 for invalid input and 3 for strict scan warnings.
sandbox: missing path and empty temporary directory

claim: The CLI scans the bundled local files without a Supabase credential.
where: Landing first screen and limits section, README
sandbox: bundled demo with an empty SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; assert a local-only report

claim: The CLI does not make network requests while scanning local files.
sandbox: bundled demo behind a recording HTTP(S) proxy; assert no proxy requests and no HTTP client dependency

claim: The CLI leaves input files unchanged and does not include auth-data files in its report.
where: Landing limits section, README, privacy notice
sandbox: temporary project with SQL and a sentinel auth users file; compare input contents and report output

claim: The guide works offline after its first visit.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:offline-reload'
sandbox: fresh browser context; first visit; wait for service worker; offline reload

claim: The demo shows a populated sample report and uses a separate demo storage key.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:demo-sandbox'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; inspect eleven findings, reset action, and localStorage

claim: The demo page makes no third-party requests.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:site-privacy'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; record each request origin

claim: A valid returned license unlocks Planning Room on that browser.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:license-restore'
sandbox: recorded valid verifier response; license query parameter; inspect local unlock and cleaned URL

claim: Planning Room saves an imported plan in browser storage without uploading the report.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:local-planning'
sandbox: recorded valid verifier response; load sample plan; save; inspect storage and outgoing request bodies

claim: Planning Room is displayed as a USD $19 one-time license and does not link to the unregistered checkout.
test: npm run build:site && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test -g '@claim:planning-price'
sandbox: fresh browser at the Planning Room section; inspect the price, pending status, and purchase-link absence
